authority.headline: A decade growing contractors. Then we built the missing piece.
authority.body: LeadsForward has spent 10 years helping home-service companies fill their calendars. Across that work we generated 250,000+ leads that helped contractors book $150 million in revenue — and we kept seeing the same gap: finished jobs that never became marketing. JobCapturePro is how we closed it.

items.q: Do my technicians need to write marketing content?
items.a: No. They capture the job like they already do. JobCapturePro builds the usable proof from the photo, job, and location data.
No. JobCapturePro is the proof and marketing layer. It can sit alongside the tools you already use.
No. Rankings depend on many factors. JCP helps you publish consistent real-job proof that can support local visibility — it does not promise ranking outcomes.

items.q: What does my crew actually have to do?
items.a: Capture the job (and show a QR for reviews when you use that flow). The system handles the downstream content.

items.q: What do I need for the demo?
items.a: Pick your trade and a work email to personalize the experience. A mobile number helps us follow up if you want setup help — no credit card.
